title: Deferred versus Immediate scale-down
provenance: Production buildRolloutInputs + rolloutStateForRevision + ComputeNextStep + validateUpdateStep. Input observations and readiness timing are simulated, not a Kubernetes recording. Every prelude state is reached through the actual planner. Ordinal and Hash inputs are checked identical; deletions conservatively remove Ready groups first. Both scale-down paths preserve the same loading groups and receive identical readiness-completion increments (2/1, 2/0, 3/1). Deferred's final steady-state cleanup is separately labeled and occurs only when every group is Ready.
Panels are aligned to shared external events, not wall-clock duration. Tile IDs are illustration identities, not Kubernetes Pod UIDs.

source.format: Finite Canvas primitives, original state boundaries, 24fps sampled decorative motion. No domain calculations at playback.
